scripts.text:
DELETE FROM EDS.DEP_CUSTREPRINTTBL WHERE AS_OF_DATE = (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_CUSTREPRINTTBL);

INSERT INTO EDS.DEP_CUSTREPRINTTBL
(
    AS_OF_DATE
    ,BENEFICIARY
    ,REMITTER
    ,BENE_TIN
    ,REMITTER_TIN
    ,COUNTRY
    ,TRAN_CODE
    ,CHRG_COLL_FLG
    ,CHRG_TRAN_ID
    ,MODE_OF_PAY
    ,REPRESENTATIVE_NAME
    ,TRAN_ID
    ,DTH_INIT_SOL_ID
    ,TRAN_DATE
    ,TD_REF_NO
    ,TD_WITHDRWL_TYPE
    ,PCC_CODE
    ,MRT_NAME
    ,FREE_TEXT
    ,MOP_ID
    ,PCC_CODE_DR
    ,PCC_CODE_CR
    ,OAP_REF_NUM_DR
    ,OAP_REF_NUM_CR
    ,ACCTS_OFFICER_CODE
    ,CIF_ID
    ,REMARKS3
    ,CHQ_NO_CR
    ,CHQ_NO_DR
    ,PN_REF_NUM
    ,REF_EBP_NUM
    ,ORIG_TRAN_ID
    ,BANK_ID
    ,RCRE_USER_ID
    ,RCRE_TIME
    ,OTHER_BANK_ID
    ,BNK_CODE
    ,SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
    CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS AS_OF_DATE
    ,BENEFICIARY
    ,REMITTER
    ,BENE_TIN
    ,REMITTER_TIN
    ,COUNTRY
    ,TRAN_CODE
    ,CHRG_COLL_FLG
    ,CHRG_TRAN_ID
    ,MODE_OF_PAY
    ,REPRESENTATIVE_NAME
    ,TRAN_ID
    ,DTH_INIT_SOL_ID
    ,TRAN_DATE
    ,TD_REF_NO
    ,TD_WITHDRWL_TYPE
    ,PCC_CODE
    ,MRT_NAME
    ,FREE_TEXT
    ,MOP_ID
    ,PCC_CODE_DR
    ,PCC_CODE_CR
    ,OAP_REF_NUM_DR
    ,OAP_REF_NUM_CR
    ,ACCTS_OFFICER_CODE
    ,CIF_ID
    ,REMARKS3
    ,CHQ_NO_CR
    ,CHQ_NO_DR
    ,PN_REF_NUM
    ,REF_EBP_NUM
    ,ORIG_TRAN_ID
    ,BANK_ID
    ,RCRE_USER_ID
    ,RCRE_TIME
    ,OTHER_BANK_ID
    ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
    ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,convert(datetime2,insert_dttm) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_CUSTREPRINTTBL
WHERE H = 'D'
AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE)>=CAST(RCRE_TIME AS DATE);
